svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 2 (CUMULATIVE R482) · SELF-HOSTED AGENT CLOUD & SERVERLESS S3 RAG
appwrite/appwrite v2.7.2 (Built-In MCP) + fyrr-ai/fyrr (S3 ACL RAG) + OpenVINO CPU Inference
1. appwrite/appwrite v2.7.2 (★58,141 · +239★ today · BSD-3-Clause)
• Unified Agent-First Cloud with Built-In Appwrite MCP
Auth, Databases (Postgres/MySQL/Doc), Storage, Functions, Sites, Messaging, Firewall
Coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) operate live projects via native MCP
• Hardened Self-Hosting & Upgrade Resilience
Loopback-only 127.0.0.1:20080 wizard + one-time x-appwrite-installer-secret
DOCKER_API_VERSION=1.42 compatibility flag prevents host daemon mismatch failures
3. openvinotoolkit/openvino (★11,250 · +18★ today · Apache-2.0)
Optimum Intel + openvino.genai runs INT8/INT4 /embeddings & SLMs on Xeon CPUs
Eliminates $400+/mo dedicated GPU nodes for internal RAG & Appwrite Functions
2. fyrr-ai/fyrr (★10 · Apache-2.0 · Rust 1.97+)
• "No Database. Just a Bucket." Serverless S3 Architecture
fyrr writer sync/commit publishes index + ACLs to one S3 bucket or local dir
Stateless fyrr reader serve (or AWS Lambda) scales with zero cross-node coordination
• Fail-Closed Pre-Ranking ACL Authorization
Checks FYRR_IDENTITY_KEY / OIDC inside search BEFORE ranking results
Forbidden docs look non-existent; missing permission data refuses rather than guesses
Speed & Quality (anonymized_reported, independently_reproduced=false):
16 ms median search (25 ms P95) · 90+ score on EnterpriseRAG-Bench (top of 43)
Boundary: Pre-1.0, Linux x86-64 build, plain text/MD only, external TLS proxy required
